criterion: P1b-AC2 (forced source rebuild) and the AC6 sub-criterion "one camera stalled and reconnected while 12 continue"
method: 12 real facility cameras plus one camera served by a controllable RTSP publisher; the publisher was killed mid-run and restored
verdict: PASS. The canonical camera id is unchanged across the forced rebuild - one id for the whole run - while the stream epoch rotated from 0 to 2 so post-outage frames cannot join the old stream. Each outage was counted exactly once and matched by a recovery, the other twelve cameras were untouched at zero outages, and the camera resumed detecting after reconnect.
not_established: the twelve continuing cameras are evidenced by their outage counters staying at zero, which is weaker than showing each kept delivering frames throughout the outage window
